title: Bret Hart’s world-title peak meets Goldberg
summary: Bret Hart wins WCW’s championship tournament, then defends against Goldberg. A disputed Starrcade finish overshadows the match while a real injury changes Hart’s future.

chapters.title: Hart wins the tournament
chapters.result: Hart defeats Benoit in the final for the vacant world title.
chapters.context: The Toronto victory puts Hart at the top of WCW after the championship tournament.

chapters.title: A controversial Starrcade defense
chapters.result: Hart retains against Goldberg after Piper calls for the bell during the Sharpshooter.
chapters.context: The finish echoes Montreal. Hart also suffers a real concussion during the match, separate from the scripted controversy.
